package onboardinghandoff

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/readiness"
)

const (
	handoffStudentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	handoffKey       = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
)

func TestAcceptorCreatesExactReadyReceiptAndReplays(t *testing.T) {
	students := &handoffStudents{snapshot: handoffSnapshot()}
	receipts := &handoffReceipts{}
	acceptor := newAcceptor(true, receipts, students)
	first, created, err := acceptor.Handle(context.Background(), handoffInput())
	if err != nil || !created || first.Schema != domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffSchema ||
		first.Status != domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffAccepted || first.Replayed || first.Goal.Code != "programming.foundation" ||
		first.ExecutionStatus != domain.OnboardingPlanExecutionNotStarted || first.ContentStatus != domain.OnboardingPlanContentNotCreated {
		t.Fatalf("first=%#v created=%t err=%v", first, created, err)
	}
	second, created, err := acceptor.Handle(context.Background(), handoffInput())
	if err != nil || created || !second.Replayed || second.HandoffID != first.HandoffID || students.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("second=%#v created=%t err=%v student_calls=%d", second, created, err, students.calls)
	}
}

func TestAcceptorFirstResponseMatchesPostgresPrecisionReplayTimestamp(t *testing.T) {
	students := &handoffStudents{snapshot: handoffSnapshot()}
	receipts := &postgresPrecisionReceipts{}
	clock := sequenceClock{times: []time.Time{
		time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 0, 0, 1, 123456789, time.UTC),
		time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 0, 0, 2, 987654321, time.UTC),
	}}
	acceptor := Acceptor{Enabled: true, Receipts: receipts, IDs: handoffIDs{}, Clock: &clock, Readiness: readiness.Resolver{
		Enabled: true, Students: students, Graphs: handoffGraphs{},
	}}
	first, created, err := acceptor.Handle(context.Background(), handoffInput())
	if err != nil || !created {
		t.Fatalf("first=%#v created=%t err=%v", first, created, err)
	}
	second, created, err := acceptor.Handle(context.Background(), handoffInput())
	if err != nil || created || !second.Replayed ||
		first.ReadinessObservedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano) != second.ReadinessObservedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano) {
		t.Fatalf("first=%#v second=%#v created=%t err=%v", first, second, created, err)
	}
	if got := first.ReadinessObservedAt.Nanosecond(); got != 123456000 {
		t.Fatalf("first readiness_observed_at nanoseconds=%d, want PostgreSQL microsecond precision", got)
	}
}

func TestAcceptorFlagOffReplaysOnlyExactReceiptWithoutStudentRead(t *testing.T) {
	students := &handoffStudents{snapshot: handoffSnapshot()}
	receipts := &handoffReceipts{}
	enabled := newAcceptor(true, receipts, students)
	if _, _, err := enabled.Handle(context.Background(), handoffInput()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("seed receipt: %v", err)
	}
	students.calls = 0
	disabled := newAcceptor(false, receipts, students)
	response, created, err := disabled.Handle(context.Background(), handoffInput())
	if err != nil || created || !response.Replayed || students.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("replay=%#v created=%t err=%v calls=%d", response, created, err, students.calls)
	}
	input := handoffInput()
	input.IdempotencyKey = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	if _, _, err := disabled.Handle(context.Background(), input); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrFeatureDisabled) || students.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("err=%v student_calls=%d", err, students.calls)
	}
}

func TestAcceptorRejectsWhitespacePaddedIdempotencyKeyBeforeStudentRead(t *testing.T) {
	students := &handoffStudents{snapshot: handoffSnapshot()}
	input := handoffInput()
	input.IdempotencyKey = " " + handoffKey + " "
	if _, _, err := newAcceptor(true, &handoffReceipts{}, students).Handle(context.Background(), input); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) || students.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("err=%v student_calls=%d", err, students.calls)
	}
}

func TestAcceptorRejectsIdempotencyHashAndStateRefFence(t *testing.T) {
	students := &handoffStudents{snapshot: handoffSnapshot()}
	receipts := &handoffReceipts{}
	acceptor := newAcceptor(true, receipts, students)
	if _, _, err := acceptor.Handle(context.Background(), handoffInput()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("seed receipt: %v", err)
	}
	students.calls = 0
	hashConflict := handoffInput()
	hashConflict.Request.DialogID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
	if _, _, err := acceptor.Handle(context.Background(), hashConflict); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) || students.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("hash conflict err=%v student_calls=%d", err, students.calls)
	}
	stateFence := handoffInput()
	stateFence.IdempotencyKey = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
	if _, _, err := acceptor.Handle(context.Background(), stateFence); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("state fence err=%v", err)
	}
}

func TestAcceptorRejectsStateChangeActivePathAndNotReady(t *testing.T) {
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(*domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot)
		want   error
	}{
		{name: "stale", mutate: func(s *domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot) { s.StateRef.Version++ }, want: domain.ErrStateChanged},
		{name: "active", mutate: func(s *domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot) {
			s.ActivePath = &domain.StudentReadinessActivePath{LearningPathID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Version: 1, CourseID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", GoalCode: "go.backend", Status: "ACTIVE"}
		}, want: domain.ErrActivePathExists},
		{name: "clarification", mutate: func(s *domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot) {
			s.Profile.DesiredStacks = domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayUnresolved}
		}, want: domain.ErrNotReady},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			snapshot := handoffSnapshot()
			testCase.mutate(&snapshot)
			_, _, err := newAcceptor(true, &handoffReceipts{}, &handoffStudents{snapshot: snapshot}).Handle(context.Background(), handoffInput())
			if !errors.Is(err, testCase.want) {
				t.Fatalf("err=%v want=%v", err, testCase.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestAcceptorRecordsHistoricalReadyObservationWhenPathChangesAfterObservation(t *testing.T) {
	students := &handoffStudents{snapshot: handoffSnapshot()}
	receipts := &postObservationPathReceipts{}
	acceptor := Acceptor{Enabled: true, Receipts: receipts, IDs: handoffIDs{}, Clock: handoffClock{}, Readiness: readiness.Resolver{
		Enabled: true, Students: students, Graphs: handoffGraphs{},
	}}
	result, created, err := acceptor.Handle(context.Background(), handoffInput())
	if err != nil || !created || !receipts.pathCreatedAfterObservation || students.calls != 1 || result.ReadinessObservedAt.IsZero() {
		t.Fatalf("result=%#v created=%t err=%v path_changed=%t student_calls=%d", result, created, err, receipts.pathCreatedAfterObservation, students.calls)
	}
	// S8 is an immutable historical admission only: a path created after the
	// authoritative observation is revalidated/reserved by S9 before effects.
	if result.Status != domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffAccepted || result.ExecutionStatus != domain.OnboardingPlanExecutionNotStarted || result.ContentStatus != domain.OnboardingPlanContentNotCreated {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected historical receipt %#v", result)
	}
}

func TestAcceptorSamplesObservationClockOnlyAfterExactReady(t *testing.T) {
	students := &handoffStudents{snapshot: handoffSnapshot()}
	clock := readinessAwareClock{students: students}
	acceptor := Acceptor{Enabled: true, Receipts: &handoffReceipts{}, IDs: handoffIDs{}, Clock: &clock, Readiness: readiness.Resolver{
		Enabled: true, Students: students, Graphs: handoffGraphs{},
	}}
	result, created, err := acceptor.Handle(context.Background(), handoffInput())
	if err != nil || !created || result.ReadinessObservedAt != clock.expectedObserved || result.ReadinessObservedAt.After(clock.expectedCreated) {
		t.Fatalf("result=%#v created=%t err=%v observed=%s created_at=%s", result, created, err, clock.expectedObserved, clock.expectedCreated)
	}
}

func newAcceptor(enabled bool, receipts *handoffReceipts, students *handoffStudents) Acceptor {
	return Acceptor{Enabled: enabled, Receipts: receipts, IDs: handoffIDs{}, Clock: handoffClock{}, Readiness: readiness.Resolver{
		Enabled: true, Students: students, Graphs: handoffGraphs{},
	}}
}

func handoffInput() AcceptInput {
	return AcceptInput{StudentID: handoffStudentID, IdempotencyKey: handoffKey, Request: domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest{
		Schema:           domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequestSchema,
		ExpectedStateRef: domain.StudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.StudentReadinessStateDraft, Version: 5},
		DialogID:         "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", TeacherJobID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
	}}
}

func handoffSnapshot() domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot {
	return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{Schema: domain.StudentReadinessSnapshotSchema, StudentID: handoffStudentID,
		StateRef:       domain.StudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.StudentReadinessStateDraft, Version: 5},
		LearningIntent: &domain.StudentReadinessLearningIntent{Code: "learn_programming", Source: "onboarding_goal_code.v1", Provenance: "accepted_student_draft"},
		Profile: domain.StudentReadinessProfile{DirectionCode: "undecided", SelfAssessedExperience: "beginner",
			KnownStacks:       domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered},
			DesiredStacks:     domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered},
			PreferredLanguage: &domain.StudentReadinessLanguage{Code: "ru", Provenance: "explicit_ui"},
			ContentLanguage:   &domain.StudentReadinessLanguage{Code: "ru", Provenance: "explicit_ui", Source: "preferred_language"},
		},
	}
}

type handoffStudents struct {
	snapshot domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot
	calls    int
}

func (stub *handoffStudents) GetPlanningReadiness(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot, error) {
	stub.calls++
	return stub.snapshot, nil
}

type handoffGraphs struct{}

func (handoffGraphs) GetPublishedGoalGraphExact(_ context.Context, code, version, graphVersion string) (domain.GoalGraph, error) {
	return domain.GoalGraph{Goal: domain.LearningGoal{Code: code, Version: version, GraphVersion: graphVersion, Title: "Foundation"}, Targets: []domain.LearningTarget{{Ref: domain.TargetRef{Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: "programming.execution-state", Version: "v1"}, Title: "State", ModuleCode: "module", ModuleTitle: "Module", SectionCode: "section", SectionTitle: "Section", LessonCode: "lesson", LessonTitle: "Lesson"}}}, nil
}

type handoffIDs struct{}

func (handoffIDs) NewID() string { return "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888" }

type handoffClock struct{}

func (handoffClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC) }

type readinessAwareClock struct {
	students         *handoffStudents
	afterReadyCalls  int
	expectedObserved time.Time
	expectedCreated  time.Time
}

func (clock *readinessAwareClock) Now() time.Time {
	if clock.students.calls == 0 {
		return time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	}
	clock.afterReadyCalls++
	if clock.expectedObserved.IsZero() {
		clock.expectedObserved = time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 0, 0, 1, 0, time.UTC)
		clock.expectedCreated = time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 0, 0, 2, 0, time.UTC)
	}
	if clock.afterReadyCalls == 1 {
		return clock.expectedObserved
	}
	return clock.expectedCreated
}

type handoffReceipts struct {
	records map[string]domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord
}

// postgresPrecisionReceipts models the only timestamp transformation made by
// PostgreSQL timestamptz, so this unit regression protects first/replay wire
// equality. A real-PG counterpart belongs to the authorized live acceptance.
type postgresPrecisionReceipts struct{ handoffReceipts }

func (stub *postgresPrecisionReceipts) CreateOrGetOnboardingPlanHandoff(ctx context.Context, record domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord) (domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, bool, error) {
	record.ReadinessObservedAt = record.ReadinessObservedAt.Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	record.CreatedAt = record.CreatedAt.Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	return stub.handoffReceipts.CreateOrGetOnboardingPlanHandoff(ctx, record)
}

type sequenceClock struct {
	times []time.Time
	now   int
}

func (clock *sequenceClock) Now() time.Time {
	value := clock.times[clock.now]
	clock.now++
	return value
}

type postObservationPathReceipts struct {
	handoffReceipts
	pathCreatedAfterObservation bool
}

func (stub *postObservationPathReceipts) CreateOrGetOnboardingPlanHandoff(ctx context.Context, record domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord) (domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, bool, error) {
	stub.pathCreatedAfterObservation = true
	return stub.handoffReceipts.CreateOrGetOnboardingPlanHandoff(ctx, record)
}

func (stub *handoffReceipts) GetByStudentAndIdempotency(_ context.Context, studentID, key string) (domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, error) {
	if stub.records == nil {
		return domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	record, ok := stub.records[studentID+key]
	if !ok {
		return domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return record, nil
}
func (stub *handoffReceipts) CreateOrGetOnboardingPlanHandoff(_ context.Context, record domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord) (domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, bool, error) {
	if stub.records == nil {
		stub.records = map[string]domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{}
	}
	key := record.StudentID + record.IdempotencyKey
	if existing, ok := stub.records[key]; ok {
		if existing.RequestHash != record.RequestHash {
			return domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return existing, false, nil
	}
	for _, existing := range stub.records {
		if existing.StudentID == record.StudentID && existing.StateRef == record.StateRef {
			return domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
	}
	stub.records[key] = record
	return record, true, nil
}
